question: Compare o IDHM médio dos municípios do RS com taxa de mortalidade hospitalar acima e abaixo da média estadual (mínimo de 500 internações).

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?

generated_sql: WITH internacoes_por_ano AS ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY ano ), ano_comparativo AS ( SELECT a1.ano, a1.total_internacoes AS total_ano_atual, a2.total_internacoes AS total_ano_anterior, (a1.total_internacoes - a2.total_internacoes) * 100.0 / NULLIF(a2.total_internacoes, 0) AS crescimento_percentual FROM internacoes_por_ano a1 LEFT JOIN internacoes_por_ano a2 ON a1.ano = a2.ano + 1 WHERE a1.ano IN (2008, 2023) ) SELECT ano, crescimento_percentual FROM ano_comparativo;

question: Quais são os 10 municípios do RS com taxa de mortalidade acima da média estadual (considerando apenas municípios com mais de 500 internações)?
gold_sql: WITH media_rs AS (SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_media FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS'), por_municipio AS (SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) SELECT pm.nome, pm.total_internacoes, pm.taxa_mortalidade FROM por_municipio pm, media_rs mr WHERE pm.taxa_mortalidade > mr.taxa_media ORDER BY pm.taxa_mortalidade DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Qual o hospital com maior receita total por especialidade médica, considerando apenas hospitais com mais de 500 internações na especialidade?

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior crescimento absoluto de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p2.n2 - p1.n1) AS crescimento_absoluto FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY crescimento_absoluto DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH periodo_1 AS ( SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS total_2008_2012 FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 GROUP BY i."DIAG_PRINC" ), periodo_2 AS ( SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS total_2019_2023 FROM internacoes i WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY i."DIAG_PRINC" ) SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COALESCE(p2.total_2019_2023, 0) - COALESCE(p1.total_2008_2012, 0) AS delta_internacoes, COALESCE(p2.total_2019_2023, 0) AS total_2019_2023, COALESCE(p1.total_2008_2012, 0) AS total_2008_2012 FROM periodo_1 p1 FULL OUTER JOIN periodo_2 p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON COALESCE(p1."DIAG_PRINC", p2."DIAG_PRINC") = c."CID" ORDER BY delta_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Qual a razão entre internações masculinas e femininas em UTI por ano, considerando apenas internações cirúrgicas (ESPEC = 1)?
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 1 THEN 1 END) AS homens_uti, COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 3 THEN 1 END) AS mulheres_uti, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 1 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN "SEXO" = 3 THEN 1 END), 0), 2) AS razao_h_m_pct FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND "ESPEC" = 1 AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;

question: Qual o custo médio de UTI por especialidade médica e sexo do paciente, considerando apenas internações com custo de UTI registrado?

question: Qual o total e o percentual de internações por doenças respiratórias (CID J%) em cada trimestre do ano no estado do RS?

question: Quais municípios com mais de 500 internações aparecem simultaneamente no top-20 de volume e no top-20 de taxa de mortalidade nos estados MA e RS?
gold_sql: WITH top_volume AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20), top_mortalidade AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT tv.nome FROM top_volume tv WHERE tv.nome IN (SELECT nome FROM top_mortalidade) ORDER BY tv.nome;

question: Quais procedimentos, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% do total de atendimentos realizados?
gold_sql: SELECT nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_atendimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_atendimentos DESC;

question: Compare o IDHM médio dos municípios do RS com taxa de mortalidade hospitalar acima e abaixo da média estadual (mínimo de 500 internações).
gold_sql: WITH media_rs AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS'), mortalidade_mun AS (SELECT mu.codigo_6d, mu.nome, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_mort FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY mu.codigo_6d, mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) SELECT CASE WHEN mm.taxa_mort > mr.taxa_media THEN 'Acima da media' ELSE 'Abaixo da media' END AS grupo, COUNT(*) AS qtd_municipios, ROUND(AVG(s.valor), 4) AS idhm_medio FROM mortalidade_mun mm, media_rs mr JOIN socioeconomico s ON mm.codigo_6d = s.codigo_6d AND s.metrica = 'idhm' GROUP BY CASE WHEN mm.taxa_mort > mr.taxa_media THEN 'Acima da media' ELSE 'Abaixo da media' END ORDER BY idhm_medio;

question: Qual a média móvel de 3 anos de internações no estado do RS por ano (2008-2023)?

question: Como se distribuem os hospitais em quartis de volume de internações? Mostre o número de hospitais e o intervalo de internações por quartil.

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais municípios com mais de 1000 internações têm taxa de internação em UTI mais de duas vezes acima da média nacional?
gold_sql: WITH media_nacional AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_uti_local, ROUND(mn.taxa_uti_nacional, 2) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_nacional mn GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mn.taxa_uti_nacional HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 2 * mn.taxa_uti_nacional ORDER BY taxa_uti_local DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais são os 10 municípios com maior taxa de mortalidade em internações obstétricas, entre aqueles com mais de 200 internações obstétricas e taxa acima da média nacional obstétrica?
gold_sql: WITH media_obs AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media_obstetrica FROM internacoes i WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_obstetrico, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_mort_obstetrica, ROUND(mo.taxa_media_obstetrica, 4) AS media_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_obs mo WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mo.taxa_media_obstetrica HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > mo.taxa_media_obstetrica ORDER BY taxa_mort_obstetrica DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais são os 10 municípios do Maranhão com Bolsa Família acima da média estadual e mortalidade infantil abaixo da média estadual?

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Como se distribuem os hospitais em quartis de volume de internações? Mostre o número de hospitais e o intervalo de internações por quartil.
gold_sql: SELECT ntile_grupo, COUNT(*) AS total_hospitais, MIN(total_internacoes) AS min_internacoes, MAX(total_internacoes) AS max_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes), 0) AS media_internacoes FROM (SELECT "CNES", total_internacoes, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS ntile_grupo FROM (SELECT "CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes GROUP BY "CNES") sub) ranked GROUP BY ntile_grupo ORDER BY ntile_grupo;

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais os 3 hospitais com maior valor médio de serviço hospitalar (VAL_SH) por estado (MA e RS), considerando hospitais com mais de 500 internações?

generated_sql: SELECT ano, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sexo = 1) AS total_masculino, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sexo = 3) AS total_feminino, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sexo = 1) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sexo = 3), 0) AS razao FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, i."SEXO" FROM internacoes i WHERE i."VAL_UTI" > 0 AND i."ESPEC" = 1 AND i."SEXO" IN (1, 3) ) sub GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano;

question: Quais são os 10 hospitais com mais de 1000 internações que nunca registraram nenhuma internação em UTI?

question: Qual o custo médio de UTI por especialidade médica e sexo do paciente, considerando apenas internações com custo de UTI registrado?

question: Qual o total e o percentual de internações por doenças respiratórias (CID J%) em cada trimestre do ano no estado do RS?

question: Quais municípios com mais de 500 internações aparecem simultaneamente no top-20 de volume e no top-20 de taxa de mortalidade nos estados MA e RS?
gold_sql: WITH top_volume AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20), top_mortalidade AS (SELECT mu.nome FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20) SELECT tv.nome FROM top_volume tv WHERE tv.nome IN (SELECT nome FROM top_mortalidade) ORDER BY tv.nome;

question: Quais procedimentos, ordenados por volume decrescente, cobrem até 80% do total de atendimentos realizados?
gold_sql: SELECT nome_proc FROM (SELECT p."NOME_PROC" AS nome_proc, COUNT(*) AS total_atendimentos, ROUND(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 2) AS pct_acumulado FROM atendimentos a JOIN procedimentos p ON a."PROC_REA" = p."PROC_REA" GROUP BY p."NOME_PROC") sub WHERE pct_acumulado <= 80 ORDER BY total_atendimentos DESC;

question: Compare o IDHM médio dos municípios do RS com taxa de mortalidade hospitalar acima e abaixo da média estadual (mínimo de 500 internações).
gold_sql: WITH media_rs AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS'), mortalidade_mun AS (SELECT mu.codigo_6d, mu.nome, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_mort FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY mu.codigo_6d, mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) SELECT CASE WHEN mm.taxa_mort > mr.taxa_media THEN 'Acima da media' ELSE 'Abaixo da media' END AS grupo, COUNT(*) AS qtd_municipios, ROUND(AVG(s.valor), 4) AS idhm_medio FROM mortalidade_mun mm, media_rs mr JOIN socioeconomico s ON mm.codigo_6d = s.codigo_6d AND s.metrica = 'idhm' GROUP BY CASE WHEN mm.taxa_mort > mr.taxa_media THEN 'Acima da media' ELSE 'Abaixo da media' END ORDER BY idhm_medio;
generated_sql: WITH media_estado AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS'), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) SELECT pm.nome AS municipio, ROUND(AVG(s."valor"), 2) AS idhm, pm.taxa FROM por_municipio pm JOIN socioeconomico s ON pm.nome = s.codigo_6d WHERE s.metrica = 'idhm' GROUP BY pm.nome, pm.taxa ORDER BY pm.taxa DESC;

question: Qual a média móvel de 3 anos de internações no estado do RS por ano (2008-2023)?
gold_sql: SELECT ano, total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes) OVER (ORDER BY ano ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0) AS media_movel_3anos FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'RS' AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano) sub ORDER BY ano;

question: Como se distribuem os hospitais em quartis de volume de internações? Mostre o número de hospitais e o intervalo de internações por quartil.

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH periodo_1 AS ( SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."DT_INTER" BETWEEN '2008-01-01' AND '2012-12-31' GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO"), periodo_2 AS ( SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE i."DT_INTER" BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2023-12-31' GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO") SELECT p1.diagnostico, p1.total AS total_periodo_1, COALESCE(p2.total, 0) AS total_periodo_2, (p1.total - COALESCE(p2.total, 0)) AS delta FROM periodo_1 p1 LEFT JOIN periodo_2 p2 ON p1.diagnostico = p2.diagnostico ORDER BY delta DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais municípios com mais de 1000 internações têm taxa de internação em UTI mais de duas vezes acima da média nacional?
gold_sql: WITH media_nacional AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_uti_local, ROUND(mn.taxa_uti_nacional, 2) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_nacional mn GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mn.taxa_uti_nacional HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 2 * mn.taxa_uti_nacional ORDER BY taxa_uti_local DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais são os 10 municípios com maior taxa de mortalidade em internações obstétricas, entre aqueles com mais de 200 internações obstétricas e taxa acima da média nacional obstétrica?
gold_sql: WITH media_obs AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media_obstetrica FROM internacoes i WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_obstetrico, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_mort_obstetrica, ROUND(mo.taxa_media_obstetrica, 4) AS media_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_obs mo WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mo.taxa_media_obstetrica HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > mo.taxa_media_obstetrica ORDER BY taxa_mort_obstetrica DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Qual a média de dias de internação por especialidade médica, comparando lado a lado os estados MA e RS?

question: Quais são os 10 municípios do Maranhão com Bolsa Família acima da média estadual e mortalidade infantil abaixo da média estadual?
gold_sql: WITH media_ma AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'bolsa_familia_total' THEN s.valor END) AS avg_bf, AVG(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' THEN s.valor END) AS avg_mi FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios mu ON s.codigo_6d = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'MA'), por_municipio AS (SELECT mu.nome, MAX(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'bolsa_familia_total' THEN s.valor END) AS bolsa_familia, MAX(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' THEN s.valor END) AS mort_infantil FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios mu ON s.codigo_6d = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'MA' GROUP BY mu.nome) SELECT pm.nome, pm.bolsa_familia, pm.mort_infantil FROM por_municipio pm, media_ma mm WHERE pm.bolsa_familia > mm.avg_bf AND pm.mort_infantil < mm.avg_mi AND pm.bolsa_familia IS NOT NULL AND pm.mort_infantil IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pm.bolsa_familia DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior crescimento absoluto de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?

question: Como se distribuem os hospitais em quartis de volume de internações? Mostre o número de hospitais e o intervalo de internações por quartil.
gold_sql: SELECT ntile_grupo, COUNT(*) AS total_hospitais, MIN(total_internacoes) AS min_internacoes, MAX(total_internacoes) AS max_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(total_internacoes), 0) AS media_internacoes FROM (SELECT "CNES", total_internacoes, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS ntile_grupo FROM (SELECT "CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes GROUP BY "CNES") sub) ranked GROUP BY ntile_grupo ORDER BY ntile_grupo;

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais municípios com mais de 1000 internações têm taxa de internação em UTI mais de duas vezes acima da média nacional?

question: Como se distribuem os hospitais em quartis de volume de internações? Mostre o número de hospitais e o intervalo de internações por quartil.

generated_sql: WITH hospital_volume AS ( SELECT i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i GROUP BY i."CNES" ), quartis AS ( SELECT "CNES", total_internacoes, NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY total_internacoes) AS quartil FROM hospital_volume ) SELECT quartil, COUNT(*) AS numero_hospitais, MIN(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_minimo, MAX(total_internacoes) AS intervalo_maximo FROM quartis GROUP BY quartil ORDER BY quartil;

question: Quais são os 10 diagnósticos com maior queda absoluta de internações entre os períodos 2008-2012 e 2019-2023?
gold_sql: WITH p1 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n1 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC"), p2 AS (SELECT "DIAG_PRINC", COUNT(*) AS n2 FROM internacoes WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 AND "DIAG_PRINC" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "DIAG_PRINC") SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO", p1.n1 AS periodo_2008_2012, p2.n2 AS periodo_2019_2023, (p1.n1 - p2.n2) AS queda_absoluta FROM p1 JOIN p2 ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = p2."DIAG_PRINC" JOIN cid c ON p1."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE p1.n1 > 1000 ORDER BY queda_absoluta DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH periodo_1 AS ( SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2012 GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ), periodo_2 AS ( SELECT c."CD_DESCRICAO" AS diagnostico, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i JOIN cid c ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM i."DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023 GROUP BY c."CD_DESCRICAO" ) SELECT p1.diagnostico, p1.total_internacoes AS total_periodo_1, COALESCE(p2.total_internacoes, 0) AS total_periodo_2, (p1.total_internacoes - COALESCE(p2.total_internacoes, 0)) AS delta FROM periodo_1 p1 LEFT JOIN periodo_2 p2 ON p1.diagnostico = p2.diagnostico ORDER BY delta DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais municípios com mais de 1000 internações têm taxa de internação em UTI mais de duas vezes acima da média nacional?
gold_sql: WITH media_nacional AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_uti_local, ROUND(mn.taxa_uti_nacional, 2) AS taxa_uti_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_nacional mn GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mn.taxa_uti_nacional HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > 2 * mn.taxa_uti_nacional ORDER BY taxa_uti_local DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH media_nacional AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes ), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu."nome" AS municipio, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."VAL_UTI" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_uti FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."nome" HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ) SELECT pm.municipio, pm.total_internacoes, ROUND(pm.taxa_uti, 2) AS taxa_internacao_uti FROM por_municipio pm, media_nacional mn WHERE pm.taxa_uti > mn.taxa_ref * 2 ORDER BY taxa_internacao_uti DESC;

question: Quais são os 10 municípios com maior taxa de mortalidade em internações obstétricas, entre aqueles com mais de 200 internações obstétricas e taxa acima da média nacional obstétrica?
gold_sql: WITH media_obs AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_media_obstetrica FROM internacoes i WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2) SELECT mu.nome, mu.estado, COUNT(*) AS total_obstetrico, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_mortes, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 4) AS taxa_mort_obstetrica, ROUND(mo.taxa_media_obstetrica, 4) AS media_nacional FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d, media_obs mo WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome, mu.estado, mo.taxa_media_obstetrica HAVING COUNT(*) > 200 AND SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) > mo.taxa_media_obstetrica ORDER BY taxa_mort_obstetrica DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH media_nacional AS ( SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_ref FROM internacoes WHERE "ESPEC" = 2), por_municipio AS ( SELECT mu.nome, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE i."ESPEC" = 2 GROUP BY mu.nome HAVING COUNT(*) > 200) SELECT pm.nome, pm.total_internacoes, ROUND(pm.taxa_mortalidade, 2) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM por_municipio pm, media_nacional mn WHERE pm.taxa_mortalidade > mn.taxa_ref ORDER BY pm.taxa_mortalidade DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quais os 3 hospitais com maior valor médio de serviço hospitalar (VAL_SH) por estado (MA e RS), considerando hospitais com mais de 500 internações?
gold_sql: SELECT estado, "CNES", total_internacoes, avg_val_sh, rk FROM (SELECT mu.estado, i."CNES", COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_SH"), 2) AS avg_val_sh, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY mu.estado ORDER BY AVG(i."VAL_SH") DESC) AS rk FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') AND i."VAL_SH" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY mu.estado, i."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500) sub WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY estado, rk;
generated_sql: SELECT mu."estado", h."CNES", AVG(i."VAL_SH") AS media_val_sh FROM internacoes i JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mu ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mu."codigo_6d" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY mu."estado", h."CNES" HAVING COUNT(*) > 500 ORDER BY media_val_sh DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Em qual mês de cada ano (2008-2023) ocorreu o maior número de internações em UTI?
gold_sql: SELECT ano, mes, total_uti FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") AS mes, COUNT(*) AS total_uti, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano, mes) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ano;
generated_sql: SELECT ano, mes, total_internacoes FROM ( SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM "DT_INTER") AS mes, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_UTI" > 0 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") BETWEEN 2008 AND 2023 GROUP BY ano, mes ) sub WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ano, mes;

question: Qual a média de dias de internação por especialidade médica, comparando lado a lado os estados MA e RS?
gold_sql: SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mu.estado = 'MA' THEN i."DIAS_PERM" END), 2) AS media_dias_MA, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mu.estado = 'RS' THEN i."DIAS_PERM" END), 2) AS media_dias_RS, COUNT(CASE WHEN mu.estado = 'MA' THEN 1 END) AS total_MA, COUNT(CASE WHEN mu.estado = 'RS' THEN 1 END) AS total_RS FROM internacoes i JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO" HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN mu.estado = 'MA' THEN 1 END) > 100 AND COUNT(CASE WHEN mu.estado = 'RS' THEN 1 END) > 100 ORDER BY especialidade;
generated_sql: SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade, COUNT(CASE WHEN mu."estado" = 'MA' THEN 1 END) AS count_MA, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mu."estado" = 'MA' THEN i."DIAS_PERM" END), 2) AS media_MA, COUNT(CASE WHEN mu."estado" = 'RS' THEN 1 END) AS count_RS, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN mu."estado" = 'RS' THEN i."DIAS_PERM" END), 2) AS media_RS FROM internacoes i JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."codigo_6d" JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC" WHERE mu."estado" IN ('MA', 'RS') GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO" ORDER BY e."DESCRICAO";

question: Quais são os 10 municípios do Maranhão com Bolsa Família acima da média estadual e mortalidade infantil abaixo da média estadual?
gold_sql: WITH media_ma AS (SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'bolsa_familia_total' THEN s.valor END) AS avg_bf, AVG(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' THEN s.valor END) AS avg_mi FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios mu ON s.codigo_6d = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'MA'), por_municipio AS (SELECT mu.nome, MAX(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'bolsa_familia_total' THEN s.valor END) AS bolsa_familia, MAX(CASE WHEN s.metrica = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' THEN s.valor END) AS mort_infantil FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios mu ON s.codigo_6d = mu.codigo_6d WHERE mu.estado = 'MA' GROUP BY mu.nome) SELECT pm.nome, pm.bolsa_familia, pm.mort_infantil FROM por_municipio pm, media_ma mm WHERE pm.bolsa_familia > mm.avg_bf AND pm.mort_infantil < mm.avg_mi AND pm.bolsa_familia IS NOT NULL AND pm.mort_infantil IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pm.bolsa_familia DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql: WITH media_ref AS ( SELECT AVG(s."valor") AS media_bolsa_familia FROM socioeconomico s WHERE s."metrica" = 'bolsa_familia_total' ), media_mortalidade AS ( SELECT AVG(s."valor") AS media_mortalidade FROM socioeconomico s WHERE s."metrica" = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' ), municipio_bolsa AS ( SELECT mu."codigo_6d", SUM(CASE WHEN s."metrica" = 'bolsa_familia_total' THEN s."valor" ELSE 0 END) AS total_bolsa_familia, AVG(CASE WHEN s."metrica" = 'mortalidade_infantil_1ano' THEN s."valor" ELSE NULL END) AS taxa_mortalidade FROM socioeconomico s JOIN municipios mu ON s."codigo_6d" = mu."codigo_6d" GROUP BY mu."codigo_6d" ) SELECT mu."codigo_6d", total_bolsa_familia, taxa_mortalidade FROM municipio_bolsa mu WHERE total_bolsa_familia > (SELECT media_bolsa_familia FROM media_ref) AND taxa_mortalidade < (SELECT media_mortalidade FROM media_mortalidade) ORDER BY total_bolsa_familia DESC LIMIT 10;
